dct_description_sm: The overall objective is to obtain the first exposure information for northern populations to HBCD, a potential persistent organic pollutant (POP). This will be accomplished by the determination of HBCD in: i) 23 human blood plasma purified extracts originating from composites formed from individual samples collected in the years 1994 up to 1999 from several ethnic groups from all regions of Nunavut and the Northwest Territories. ii) 40 human milk purified extracts originating from individual milk samples collected in 1989-1990 and 1996-2000 from Inuits residing mostly in the east coast of Hudson Bay, Nunavik. An estimation of the relative risk of this exposure for these northern communities will be made by comparison of the generated data to that from cities in the south of Canada (ongoing work at Health Canada).

dct_title_s: Assessment of archived human sample extracts collected in northern regions for the brominated flame retardant, hexabromocyclododecane (HBCD)
